project_type: C/C++ cryptographic library implementing MPC threshold signing protocols (CMP-ECDSA, BAM, EdDSA, FROST)
test_framework: Catch2 test framework with custom test helpers
build_command: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. && make
verification_instructions: Build with CMake, run test suite
setup_instructions: apt install build-essential libssl-dev uuid-dev libsecp256k1-dev && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && make
contribution_requirements: Security findings should follow SECURITY-MODEL.md guidelines
key_patterns: Uses OpenSSL BN for big number operations, BN_FLG_CONSTTIME for sensitive values, OPENSSL_cleanse for secret cleanup, drng for Fiat-Shamir challenges
directory_structure: src/common/crypto/ has primitives (paillier, commitments, ZKPs, EC algebras, DRNG); src/common/cosigner/ has protocol implementations; include/ has public headers; test/ has Catch2 tests
